name: mk-lang
description: Mk language support: highlighting, and navigation, hover and diagnostics through mk lsp.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode only highlighting, snippets and editing support work: the language server (mk lsp) starts once the folder is trusted.

mk.server.path.markdownDescription: The `mk` executable that runs `mk lsp --stdio`. `${workspaceFolder}` and a leading `~` are expanded. Empty: `mk` (`mk.exe` on Windows) at the root of a workspace folder if there is one, else `mk` on `PATH`. Build it from a source checkout with `go build -o mk ./cmd/mk`.

mk.server.std.markdownDescription: The standard library directory, passed as `--std`. Empty: a workspace folder's `std` directory when that folder is the Mk repository (it holds `std/pkg.mk` and `cmd/mk`), else the std embedded in `mk`. With a directory, definitions into std open the real files instead of a read-only copy under the cache.

mk.server.cache.markdownDescription: The module cache directory, passed as `--cache`. Empty: `MK_CACHE`, else the per-user cache.

mk.server.log.markdownDescription: A file the server appends one line per message to, with its wall time (`--log`). Empty: no log.

mk.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace the messages between VS Code and `mk lsp` in the Mk output channel.
